SELECT o.*, d.name AS damageStatusName, a.name AS adStatusName, ar.area_name AS areaName, u.user_name AS supervisorName, w.name AS warningTypeName, r.order_no AS orderNo, os.name AS orderStatusName, ur.user_name AS dealByName, rr.name AS reviewResultName FROM outdoor_ad o LEFT JOIN sys_damage_status d ON o.damage_status_id = d.damage_status_id LEFT JOIN sys_ad_status a ON o.ad_status_id = a.ad_status_id LEFT JOIN sys_area ar ON o.area_code = ar.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.supervisor_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_warning_type w ON o.warning_type_id = w.warning_type_id LEFT JOIN rectification_order r ON o.outdoor_ad_id = r.outdoor_ad_id LEFT JOIN sys_order_status os ON r.order_status_id = os.order_status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ur ON r.deal_by = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_review_result rr ON r.review_result_id = rr.review_result_id
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT ar.area_name AS areaName, COUNT(*) AS warningCount FROM outdoor_ad o LEFT JOIN sys_area ar ON o.area_code = ar.area_code WHERE o.warning_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND NOW() GROUP BY ar.area_name ORDER BY warningCount DESC
SELECT DATE(warning_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS warningCount FROM outdoor_ad WHERE warning_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND NOW() GROUP BY DATE(warning_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT a.name AS statusName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM outdoor_ad o LEFT JOIN sys_ad_status a ON o.ad_status_id = a.ad_status_id GROUP BY a.name
SELECT w.name AS typeName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM outdoor_ad o LEFT JOIN sys_warning_type w ON o.warning_type_id = w.warning_type_id GROUP BY w.name
SELECT rr.name AS resultName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rectification_order r LEFT JOIN sys_review_result rr ON r.review_result_id = rr.review_result_id GROUP BY rr.name
